title: Spirals in sunflowers

transcript.content: i counted the spiral rows of seeds in the sunflower head from the school garden — there were 34 going one way and 55 going the other. those are both fibonacci numbers!
Nice counting! Why do you think a sunflower would end up using that particular number pattern?

it's actually the exact same pattern that shows up in nautilus shells and hurricanes, and I read that Renaissance painters used the golden ratio for 'pleasing' proportions too, like in some of Da Vinci's paintings. so the same number rule that helps a plant pack its seeds efficiently is basically the same ratio artists were using on purpose for beauty — it's like the math is a hidden thread connecting biology and art
